title: 原神元素反应：同一把火，两种算法

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 2 期
scenes.title: 翻倍是怎么算的？

lines.zh: 胡桃一枪火打在怪身上，怪物头顶亮起一个小小的火元素图标。
lines.en: Hu Tao lands a fiery strike, and a tiny Pyro icon lights up over the enemy's head.

lines.zh: 再补一下水，伤害直接翻倍。你有没有想过，这个翻倍是怎么算出来的？
lines.en: Add a splash of Hydro and the damage doubles. Have you ever wondered how that doubling is worked out?

lines.zh: 上期我们拆了塞尔达的化学引擎，这期接着拆原神：同一把火，两种算法。
lines.en: Last time we took apart Zelda's chemistry engine. This time, Genshin: the same fire, two algorithms.

scenes.title: 算世界 vs 算伤害

lines.zh: 塞尔达的火，是写进世界的状态，它会沿着格子传给下一片草。
lines.en: Zelda's fire is a state written into the world. It passes from cell to cell, into the next patch of grass.

lines.zh: 原神的火也能点草，但战斗真正围绕的，是附着在敌人身上的一个量。
lines.en: Genshin's fire can light grass too, but combat really revolves around an amount attached to the enemy.

lines.zh: 玩家把这个量叫做元素量，单位是 U。一次普通的火元素攻击，通常是 1U。
lines.en: Players call it the elemental gauge, measured in units, U. A typical Pyro hit applies 1U.

lines.zh: 但据玩家实测，打上去以后只剩 0.8U，这两成的损耗被叫作附着税。
lines.en: But player testing shows only 0.8U remains. That twenty percent loss is called the aura tax.

lines.zh: 它还会按固定速度衰减，1U 的附着，大约九点五秒后消失。
lines.en: It also decays at a fixed rate. A 1U aura is gone after about nine and a half seconds.

lines.zh: 同种元素再打一次，元素量取较大的那个，不会叠加。
lines.en: Hit with the same element again, and the gauge takes the larger value. It does not stack.

lines.zh: 那反应是什么？其实就是后打上去的元素，去消耗已经附着的元素。
lines.en: So what is a reaction? The element that arrives second consumes the aura already there.

lines.zh: 水打在火上叫强蒸发，伤害乘二，但要消耗两倍的火。
lines.en: Hydro on Pyro is a strong Vaporize: damage times two, but it eats twice the Pyro.

lines.zh: 反过来火打在水上是弱蒸发，伤害乘一点五，只消耗一半的水。
lines.en: Pyro on Hydro is the weak version: damage times one and a half, consuming only half the Hydro.

lines.zh: 超载、感电这类剧变反应不一样，它们不吃暴击，只看角色等级和元素精通。
lines.en: Transformative reactions like Overloaded and Electro-Charged differ: no crits, only character level and Elemental Mastery.

lines.zh: 还有一条隐藏规则，叫元素附着冷却。
lines.en: There is one more hidden rule: the element application cooldown.

lines.zh: 大多数攻击每三下、或者每两点五秒，才会真正挂上一次元素。
lines.en: Most attacks only apply their element once every three hits, or every two and a half seconds.

lines.zh: 所以连射七箭，可能只有第一、第四、第七箭带上了火。
lines.en: So of seven rapid arrows, perhaps only the first, fourth and seventh carry Pyro.

lines.zh: 写成代码其实不复杂。每个敌人身上挂一张附着表：元素、元素量、衰减速度。
lines.en: In code it is not complicated. Each enemy carries an aura table: element, gauge and decay rate.

lines.zh: 打中时先查冷却，再查附着表，能反应就按倍率消耗，不能反应就附着上去。
lines.en: On hit, check the cooldown, then the aura table: react and consume by the multiplier, or attach the new element.

lines.zh: 最后按反应类型算伤害，整个系统都发生在一个单位的头顶。
lines.en: Finally compute damage by reaction type. The whole system lives above one target's head.

lines.zh: 我们把这套规则也做成了能玩的网页：先给木桩挂火，再浇一下水。
lines.en: We turned these rules into a playable web page too: put Pyro on a training dummy, then add Hydro.

lines.zh: 看头顶的附着条怎么被一口吃掉，伤害数字又是怎么翻倍的。
lines.en: Watch the aura bar get eaten in one bite, and the damage number double.

lines.zh: 塞尔达算的是世界，规则在格子之间传播；原神算的是伤害，规则在单位身上结算。
lines.en: Zelda computes the world: rules spread between cells. Genshin computes damage: rules resolve on each unit.

lines.zh: 两种做法没有高下，都是用少数规则，乘出大量的玩法。
lines.en: Neither is better. Both multiply a few rules into a huge amount of play.

lines.zh: 你更喜欢哪一种？评论区告诉我。
lines.en: Which do you prefer? Tell me in the comments.

lines.zh: 下一期，我们换个问题：为什么有的敌人，好像比你先知道你要按什么键？
lines.en: Next time, a different question: why do some enemies seem to know which button you'll press before you do?

lines.zh: 从魂系列的读指令，讲到影之刃零。
lines.en: From input reading in the Souls games, all the way to Phantom Blade Zero.

lines.zh: 如果这期对你有帮助，求一个一键三连，再点个关注。
lines.en: If this helped, please like, coin and favourite, and hit follow.

lines.zh: 机制拆解下期见，我继续薅叔叔的羊毛做游戏！
lines.en: See you next time on Mechanic Breakdown. I'll keep earning from Uncle Bilibili to build my game!
